questions.text: Can a caller on {relationship} pretend to be another user or service when it reaches {destination}?

threat.name: Spoofed caller at {destination}
threat.description: A caller on {relationship} uses a stolen or forged identity to act as another user or service at {destination}.

questions.text: Can someone change the data on {relationship} between {source} and {destination}?

threat.name: Data changed in transit to {destination}
threat.description: An attacker changes the data on {relationship} between {source} and {destination}.

questions.text: Can someone change the data that {destination} stores?

threat.name: Stored data changed in {destination}
threat.description: An attacker with access to {destination} changes the data that it stores.

questions.text: Can an action on {relationship} be denied later because nothing traces it to the user who made it?

threat.name: Action on {relationship} cannot be traced to a user
threat.description: An action on {relationship} cannot be linked to the user who made it.

questions.text: Can someone read the data on {relationship} who should not see it?

threat.name: Data read in transit to {destination}
threat.description: Someone who should not see it reads the data on {relationship}.

questions.text: Can someone read the data that {destination} stores, or its backups?

threat.name: Stored data exposed from {destination}
threat.description: Data can be read if the storage of {destination} or its backups are exposed.

questions.text: Can callers on {relationship} exhaust the capacity of {destination}?

threat.name: {destination} flooded through {relationship}
threat.description: Callers on {relationship} send more requests than {destination} can handle.

questions.text: Can a caller on {relationship} do more at {destination} than it is allowed to?

threat.name: Unauthorised action at {destination}
threat.description: A caller on {relationship} does an action at {destination} that it is not allowed to do.
